name: guard_item8_grant_free_push_20261025
comment: AGENTS.md 21.0.0 §28.15 item 8 (ratified 2026-10-25, PR #2128). (a) The Cursor shell guard and bin/agent-push let
a git push run without a git-push grant only when remote main's AGENTS.md is 21.0.0+ ACTIVE, the push is one
fast-forward ref to a feature branch on origin (never main/master/release/train, never force/delete/mirror),
a live claim with an Operator-approval line or a coordinator handoff file covers the branch, and the push budget
has room; each is logged as grant-free-push. (b) npm run / npx playwright test / pytest / ruff / tsc / vite build
/ node are never deps; installs, npm ci and lockfile edits are.
